## Clinical justification

This patient has a new right-sided pleural effusion on chest X-ray, with progressive shortness of breath over three weeks. No preceding chest infection. No cardiac, hepatic, or renal cause identified. Given the unilateral nature and absence of an infective explanation, I am referring via the fast-track pleural service as per pathway guidance. No lung mass identified. Standard lung pathway criteria are not met.
